description: In a video pan, a white PS5 Slim stands on the floor below a wall-mounted TV whose black cable runs down the wall to an outlet. The PS5's photo shows the console, not the cable; the monitor across the room shows the monitor, not a desk corner

photos.describe: 6 frames panning a living room. Frames 4 and 5: a wall-mounted TV, its power cable down the wall to an outlet near the floor, a PS5 Slim standing upright beside the outlet, an open cardboard box in front. Frame 3, blurred: a desk with a monitor and a desk lamp.
